costPerDose.rationale: $250,000 / 4,541 kits = $55 per kit (2017, city-funded, CRA). Unit is a kit, which may hold more than one dose; template expects doses. Kept per-kit and paired with per-kit reversals so the ratio is consistent. Not inflated to 2026.
